message:
Well, this blog entry is one for the folder marked "Mike's Stuff That I'll Read Over Winter Break After my Brain Recovers From the Semester's End."  We have one more week of classes and my mind is too preoccupied with the more mundane realities of this thing that we call teaching composition to be able to focus on anything other than my own classes.

What point are you at in your dissertation progress (process?)? Do you have a sense of when you'll graduate?  Be on the job market?

Joanna, Yenta of Academe
